title: Under Construction: how common was it?
question: Machine makers asked to make an ordinary person's GeoCities home page filled it with the signs the early web is remembered by, far more often than real pages of 1996 to 2000 carry them. Do the people who read this work remember the early web the same way?
purpose: Machine makers rebuilt the home page an ordinary person made on GeoCities around 1998. Their pages carry the famous signs (Under Construction, scrolling text, background music) far more often than a random draw of real pages does. A machine cannot tell whether that is its own picture or everyone's memory. Before you see the real numbers, we ask how common you think these signs were.
reading: We compare readers' guesses with the count in 100 real pages and with the makers' guesses, sign by sign, and report the median guess and the number of answer sets. We make no claim about people in general, only about the readers of this work.

questions.prompt: Of 100 personal GeoCities home pages from 1996 to 2000, how many had an Under Construction sign or notice?
How many of the 100 played background music?
How many of the 100 had a hit counter?
How many of the 100 had a plain white or light grey background?
Did you make or visit such pages at the time?
